def is_nested(string):
    '''
    Return True if there is a valid subsequence of brackets where at least
    one bracket is nested. This occurs exactly when '[[' appears somewhere
    before a later ']]'.
    '''
    for i in range(len(string) - 1):
        if string[i:i + 2] == '[[' and ']]' in string[i + 2:]:
            return True
    return False
